title: Maximum on a finite set
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, and let $x\in\Omega$. Then $f(x)$ is at most the value of $f$ at a maximizer of $f$ on $\Omega$.
